title: Geometry & Trigonometry
summary: Angles, area and volume; right triangles and trigonometry; circles, arcs, radians and circle equations.
bigIdeas: Scaling lengths by $k$ scales area by $k^2$ and volume by $k^3$.
SOH CAH TOA: sine, cosine and tangent are ratios of sides in a right triangle.
An arc or sector with central angle $\theta^\circ$ is $\frac{\theta}{360}$ of the whole circle.
